intro: Sharing out chores, saying whose turn it is and telling what is already done and what is not.
p.sucia.consejo: It is the feminine of «sucio». The c sounds «th» in Spain. The opposite is «limpia».
p.limpiar.consejo: It comes from «limpio». You can clean the bathroom, the windows, the kitchen…
p.lavado.consejo: With «haber» it does not change: «he lavado», «has lavado». It is the participle of «lavar».
p.hecho.consejo: It is irregular: «he hecho», never «he hacido». The h is silent.
p.te toca.consejo: «Tocar» says whose turn it is: «me toca», «te toca», «le toca».
p.saqué.consejo: In «sacar», the c becomes qu before e: «saqué», sounding sa-KE.
p.basura.consejo: You say «sacar la basura». In Spain the bin is often split into several colours.
p.compra.consejo: «Hacer la compra» is buying what the home needs. «La compra» is feminine.
p.lavadora.consejo: It comes from «lavar». You say «poner la lavadora» to start a wash.
p.friego.consejo: In «fregar», the e becomes ie: «friego», «friegas». You scrub dishes and floors.
p.plancho.consejo: It comes from «plancha». The ch sounds as in «chico».
p.microondas.consejo: It ends in s but is singular: «el microondas», «los microondas».
p.tarea.consejo: The vowels e and a go in different syllables: ta-RE-a. Household «tareas» are many.
p.barrer.consejo: The rr is strong: ba-RRER. You sweep with a broom.
b1.titulo: Whose turn is it, and is it done?
b1.texto:
**Tocar** says whose turn it is: **me toca**, **te toca**, **le toca** + infinitive. Hoy **te toca** limpiar el baño. To stress it: **te toca a ti**.

For what you have already done today, use the **pretérito perfecto** (**haber** + participle), with **ya** or **todavía no**:

- ¿**Has lavado** los platos? — **Ya los he lavado.** / **Todavía no los he lavado.**

With **ayer** the indefinido is used: **saqué** la basura, **hice** la compra, **puse** la lavadora.

Pronouns go before **haber**: los platos → **ya los he lavado**. Irregular participles: **hecho** (hacer), **puesto** (poner).

For today, the present: tú **planchas**, yo **friego**. And **estar** + adjective: la cocina **está sucia**.
b2.f2.texto: I have not washed them yet.
b2.f3.texto: I have already made the bed.
b2.f4.texto: Today it is your turn to clean the bathroom.
b2.f5.texto: I took out the rubbish yesterday.
b2.f6.texto: I did the shopping and put the washing machine on.
b4.titulo: Perfect with ya and todavía no
b4.texto:
The **pretérito perfecto** is formed with **he, has, ha, hemos, habéis, han** + participle.

- Regular participle: **-ado** (lavar → lavado) and **-ido** (barrer → barrido).
- Irregular: **hacer → hecho**, **poner → puesto**, **ver → visto**.

It is used with **ya** (already done) and **todavía no** (not yet done): **Ya he lavado** los platos. **Todavía no he barrido**.

The pronoun goes before **haber**: **los he lavado**, **la he hecho**. And for turns: **me toca a mí**, **te toca a ti**.
b4.e0.texto: I have already washed the dishes.
b4.e2.texto: The clothes are not clean yet.
b5.f0.texto: The morning light comes in through the dirty kitchen.
b5.f1.texto: The dishes wait in the sink like a little mountain.
b5.f2.texto: Pablo opens the tap with a sleepy smile.
b5.f3.texto: The steam slowly rises to the windowpanes.
b5.f4.texto: The white foam shines on his wet hands.
b5.f5.texto: Lucía sweeps the corridor with an old broom.
b5.f6.texto: The dust flies off towards the light of the balcony.
b5.f7.texto: The washing machine spins with a steady murmur.
b5.f8.texto: The clean clothes smell of soap and sun.
b5.f9.texto: The house breathes tidy and calm at the end of the day.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! «Los platos» is masculine plural: «los».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Lo» is singular; there are several dishes.
b6.pregunta: You mean «los platos». Which pronoun is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes! «Tocar» marks whose turn it is.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That would be «te gusta»; «toca» is something else.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Here «toca» is not touching by hand, but a turn.
b8.traduccion: I have already put the washing machine on
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Saco» is present; with «ayer» you need the past.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Sacaba» is a past habit, not an event of yesterday.
b9.pregunta: With «ayer» the indefinido is used. Complete.
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «It is my turn».
b11.o0.refuerzo: That's it! «Hecho» is the irregular participle of «hacer».
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Hacido» does not exist: «hacer» has an irregular participle.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Haces» is present; with «has» a participle goes.
b12.o1: Todavía no he lavado los platos.
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Todavía no» says it is still to be done.
b12.o2: Hoy me toca lavar los platos.
b12.o2.refuerzo: That speaks of the turn, not of what is already done.
b12.pregunta: Which sentence says the task is already done?
p.fregadero.consejo: The stress is on DE. The g before a sounds hard.
p.dormida.consejo: Feminine form of «dormido», asleep or sleepy. The stress is on MI.
p.escoba.consejo: The c before o sounds like «k». The b sounds soft.
p.volando.consejo: From «volar», to fly. The gerund ends in -ndo.
p.ordenada.consejo: Feminine form of «ordenado». The stress is on NA.
